options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: assets_ttl_days
options.description: The number of days to wait before assets age out. Assets will be permanently deleted if they are not seen on a scan within the specified number of days. Minimum value 14 Maximum value 365 Warning Enabling this option will immediately delete assets in the specified network that have not been seen for the specified number of days. All asset records and associated vulnerabilities are deleted and cannot be recovered. The deleted assets no longer count towards your license.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the network object.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the network object. Must be unique within your Tenable.io instance and cannot duplicate the name of a previously deleted network or be named 'default'.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
